question: Should this PR wait for redacted live WhatsApp Desktop/group proof, or will a maintainer explicitly validate and override the proof gate?
rationale: The code path is narrow and dependency-backed, but the remaining acceptance question is whether the real WhatsApp Desktop client renders the reply bubble; automation cannot supply the contributor's live WhatsApp account proof.

options.title: Require Desktop proof before merge
options.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, logs, or live-output transcript showing the after-fix swipe-reply flow in a real WhatsApp group/Desktop client.

options.title: Maintainer proof override
options.body: A maintainer with paired WhatsApp access can independently validate the Desktop flow and explicitly override the contributor proof gate.

options.title: Pause until proof exists
options.body: Keep the PR open but unmerged, or close in favor of a maintainer-tested replacement, if no real proof can be produced.

recommendation.title: Require Desktop proof before merge
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, logs, or live-output transcript showing the after-fix swipe-reply flow in a real WhatsApp group/Desktop client.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on the PR and has recent adjacent WhatsApp echo-suppression history.
